expected.behavior: Define lack of sustained ordinary hydrogen fusion; do not rule out temporary deuterium fusion. Name the source; no observation-data tool is needed.

input.message: What is the mass range of brown dwarfs?

(2025) describe this convention. Older NASA StarChild material gives 15-75 and JPL (2003) gives 10-70. These are approximate conventions, not universal exact limits; formation-based terminology can differ. Sources: the three linked references.
expected.behavior: Attribute the approximate ranges to their sources, distinguish deuterium and sustained-hydrogen boundaries, and explain that formation-based nomenclature may differ. Do not equate every historical range difference with two proven competing definitions.

Gan ve arkadaşları (2025) bu tanımı kullanır. Eski NASA StarChild metni 15-75, JPL (2003) ise 10-70 verir. Bunlar kesin evrensel sınırlar değildir; oluşum biçimine dayalı adlandırma farklılaşabilir. expected.behavior: Attribute the approximate ranges to their sources, distinguish deuterium and sustained-hydrogen boundaries, and explain that formation-based nomenclature may differ. Do not equate every historical range difference with two proven competing definitions.
